svg.title: FIG-15 STM32F407 USART1 continuous RX: caller-owned block loans DMA2 stream2 channel4; two targets + at least one replacement block
svg.desc: Block states and token (slot + monotonic epoch); FREE: available for the next producer target; FILLING: two hardware targets + pending replacement loan Hardware may still write; do not lend to consumers; READY: old address detached from every hardware target Immutable payload with boundary / loss flags; BORROWED: consumer acquire Release the matching token after final use; Preposted reserve / explicit DMA-domain validation; FIFO publish: old block proven detached; Consumer acquire; Matching release; stale/double release cannot alter the loan; DMA TC IRQ: reserve a third FREE block Replace the completed inactive target; Prove both target addresses / CT / EN No new TC or error; old address fully removed; No FREE block / abnormal CT / new error Withdraw RX source immediately; actually disable/drain; Disable not proven: retain all producer loans Bounded task-service retries; do not reclaim consumer loans; After drain, publish a reliable positive-length prefix / LIFO-abort future loans Record observable loss / stop gaps; do not guess lost bytes; Budget: IRQ + target replacement < one block fill time Consumer frontier-release delay determines block count TC cannot recover arbitrarily coalesced wraps; rx_stop closes admission; no rearm Drain source + engine, release consumer loans, outstanding=0 Observers and callers must also exit before reuse; TC is a boundary hint; Replacement block exists; Every proof holds; Cannot replace; Any proof fails; Write source not drained; Actual write source drained; Reliable prefix and flags; Measure worst latency on hardware; Check success after loans return; Explicit stop path
